messages:
olivia xu: hey team, new hire here. my first Buildkite onboarding run failed with a 403 pulling the image. i'm on k8s agents. any quick checks?

mateo ramos: welcome! paste the error and whether you pushed to the org or are using a fork. usually ECR perms or imagePullSecret.

olivia xu: error: 
```
ERROR: Denied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/buildkite-agent-role/i-0ff1 is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken on resource: *
```

infra-bot: Tip: EKS pods use the node IAM role or IRSA service account for ECR. Local `aws ecr get-login-password` won't help pods. Check imagePullSecrets and serviceAccount IRSA annotation.

kevin zhao: do you have view perms in the `buildkite` namespace? also confirm the pipeline expects `buildkite-docker-creds` vs IRSA.

olivia xu: i don't have cluster perms yet. i accepted the GitHub App invite and pushed the branch to the org.

mateo ramos: ok i'll check. quick usual fixes: (1) create `buildkite-docker-creds` secret in the `buildkite` ns, or (2) add ecr:* actions to the IRSA role annotation service account.

(2m later)

mateo ramos: granted you `view` and patched the IRSA mapping for `buildkite-agent-sa` with ecr:GetAuthorizationToken ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer. also recreated `buildkite-docker-creds` from the CI key.

olivia xu: re-running...

(30s)

olivia xu: ✅ build passed and image pulled. thanks! what's best note to add to onboarding doc?

kevin zhao: add: check GH App + SSO, verify `buildkite-docker-creds` secret exists for k8s agents, confirm IRSA SA annotation and role includes ecr actions. Also mention ImagePullBackOff -> check events for denied errors.

olivia xu: adding that to my notes. appreciate the quick help :heart:
